title: An active agreement has evidence of acceptance and at least one allocated contractual obligation.
body: $this cd:agreementState cd:agreementState_Active. FILTER(!EXISTS {?e a cd:AgreementLifecycleEvent; cd:serviceAgreement $this; cd:agreementAction cd:agreementAction_Accept} || !EXISTS {?o a cd:ContractObligation; cd:serviceAgreement $this})

title: Fulfilled duties retain a satisfied assessment; waived duties retain a waiver assessment.
body: $this cd:obligationState ?s. FILTER(?s IN (cd:obligationState_Fulfilled,cd:obligationState_Waived)) BIND(IF(?s=cd:obligationState_Fulfilled,cd:assessmentOutcome_Satisfied,cd:assessmentOutcome_Waived) AS ?outcome) FILTER NOT EXISTS {?a a cd:ObligationAssessment; cd:contractObligation $this; cd:assessmentOutcome ?outcome}

title: Amendment and renewal create a distinct successor version retaining the contract identity.
body: $this cd:agreementAction ?a; cd:serviceAgreement ?old. FILTER(?a IN (cd:agreementAction_Amend,cd:agreementAction_Renew)) FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this cd:successorAgreement ?new. ?old cd:agreementReference ?id; cd:agreementVersion ?v1. ?new cd:agreementReference ?id; cd:agreementVersion ?v2. FILTER(?new != ?old && ?v1 != ?v2)}

title: Termination identifies who retains residual liability and the settlement cutoff.
body: $this cd:agreementAction cd:agreementAction_Terminate. FILTER(!EXISTS {$this cd:residualLiabilityOwner ?p} || !EXISTS {$this cd:settlementCutoff ?t})

title: An active entitlement is fully contained in its active backing agreement.
body: $this cd:entitlementState cd:entitlementState_Active; cd:serviceAgreement ?a; cd:validFrom ?t. OPTIONAL {$this cd:validUntil ?until} FILTER NOT EXISTS {?a cd:agreementState cd:agreementState_Active; cd:validFrom ?s. OPTIONAL {?a cd:validUntil ?e} FILTER(?t>=?s && (!BOUND(?e) || (?t<?e && BOUND(?until) && ?until<=?e)))}

title: Completed closure revokes active access and preserves ownership of any nonzero liability.
body: $this cd:closureState cd:closureState_Completed; cd:activeGrantCount ?g; cd:openLiabilityAmount ?a. FILTER(?g!=0 || !EXISTS {$this cd:completedAt ?t} || !EXISTS {$this cd:closureEvidence ?e} || (?a!=0 && !EXISTS {$this cd:residualLiabilityOwner ?p}))

title: An operating station has an accepted operational handover for that same asset.
body: $this cd:assetLifecycle cd:assetLifecycle_Operating. FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this cd:operationalAcceptance ?a. ?a cd:station $this; cd:acceptanceState cd:acceptanceState_Accepted}

title: Accepted handover requires successful safety, protocol and metering assessments and evidence.
body: $this cd:acceptanceState cd:acceptanceState_Accepted; cd:safetyAccepted ?s; cd:protocolAccepted ?p; cd:meteringAccepted ?m. FILTER(!?s || !?p || !?m || !EXISTS {$this cd:acceptedAt ?t} || !EXISTS {$this cd:acceptanceEvidence ?e})

title: Replacement and retirement cannot abandon open charging sessions or replace an asset with itself.
body: {$this cd:assetAction ?a; cd:openSessionCount ?n. FILTER(?a IN (cd:assetAction_Replace,cd:assetAction_Decommission,cd:assetAction_Dispose) && ?n>0)} UNION {$this cd:station ?s; cd:replacementStation ?s}

title: A compatible offer requires agreement of physical connector, voltage and current type.
body: $this cd:compatibilityState cd:compatibilityState_Compatible; cd:connectorTypeMatch ?c; cd:voltageMatch ?v; cd:currentTypeMatch ?t. FILTER(!?c || !?v || !?t)

title: Ad hoc offers do not require account registration.
body: $this cd:offerMode cd:offerMode_AdHoc; cd:registrationRequired true.

title: Disclosed currency, tariff currency and offer currency agree and offer expiry follows issue.
body: {$this cd:currency ?a; cd:selectedTariff/cd:currency ?b. FILTER(?a!=?b)} UNION {$this cd:currency ?a; cd:priceDisplay/cd:displayCurrency ?b. FILTER(?a!=?b)} UNION {$this cd:issuedAt ?a; cd:expiresAt ?b. FILTER(?b<=?a)}

title: Offer acceptance occurs during the disclosed offer validity window.
body: $this cd:acceptedAt ?t; cd:commercialOffer ?o. ?o cd:issuedAt ?a; cd:expiresAt ?b. FILTER(?t<?a || ?t>=?b)

title: Acceptance is bound to the same customer and selected tariff as the charging session.
body: $this cd:customer ?c; cd:session ?s; cd:commercialOffer/cd:selectedTariff ?t. FILTER NOT EXISTS {?s cd:customer ?c; cd:selectedTariff ?t}

title: The commercial supplier matches the supplier of the governing service agreement.
body: $this cd:serviceSupplier ?a; cd:serviceAgreement/cd:supplier ?b. FILTER(?a!=?b)

title: Offline admission obeys credential revocation, cache age, unknown-token policy and financial exposure limits.
body: $this cd:offlineDecision cd:offlineDecision_Allow; cd:credentialRevoked ?r; cd:cacheAgeSeconds ?a; cd:maximumCacheAgeSeconds ?m; cd:unknownCredential ?u; cd:permitUnknownCredential ?p; cd:exposureAmount ?e; cd:maximumExposureAmount ?l. FILTER(?r || ?a>?m || (?u && !?p) || ?e>?l || ?e<0 || ?l<0)

title: Duplicate delivery refers to an already applied event with matching producer, key, scope and payload and has no new effects.
body: $this cd:processingState cd:processingState_Duplicate; cd:processingContextKey ?s; cd:idempotencyKey ?k; cd:payloadDigest ?d; cd:sourceEvent/cd:sourceSystem ?producer. FILTER(EXISTS {$this cd:businessEffect ?e} || !EXISTS {$this cd:duplicateOf ?old. ?old cd:processingState cd:processingState_Applied; cd:processingContextKey ?s; cd:idempotencyKey ?k; cd:payloadDigest ?d; cd:sourceEvent/cd:sourceSystem ?producer})

title: A producer/key/scope combination has at most one applied business-effect outcome in a tenant.
body: $this cd:processingState cd:processingState_Applied; cd:tenant ?t; cd:processingContextKey ?s; cd:idempotencyKey ?k; cd:sourceEvent/cd:sourceSystem ?p. ?other a cd:EventProcessingOutcome; cd:processingState cd:processingState_Applied; cd:tenant ?t; cd:processingContextKey ?s; cd:idempotencyKey ?k; cd:sourceEvent/cd:sourceSystem ?p. FILTER(?other!=$this)

title: Quarantined events retain a reason and produce no accepted business effects.
body: $this cd:processingState cd:processingState_Quarantined. FILTER(EXISTS {$this cd:businessEffect ?e} || !EXISTS {$this cd:quarantineReason ?r})

title: Measured usage compares cumulative readings of the same register meter, unit and direction within its epoch.
body: $this cd:deltaBasis cd:deltaBasis_Measured; cd:registerEpoch ?e; cd:startReading ?a; cd:endReading ?b. ?e cd:meter ?m; cd:unitIri ?u; cd:energyDirection ?d; cd:validFrom ?start. OPTIONAL {?e cd:validUntil ?end} FILTER(!EXISTS {?a cd:meter ?m; cd:unitIri ?u; cd:energyDirection ?d; cd:readingKind cd:readingKind_Cumulative; cd:observedAt ?at. FILTER(?at>=?start)} || !EXISTS {?b cd:meter ?m; cd:unitIri ?u; cd:energyDirection ?d; cd:readingKind cd:readingKind_Cumulative; cd:observedAt ?bt. FILTER(!BOUND(?end)||?bt<?end)})

title: Measured deltas preserve ordering, multiplier and reset boundaries; estimated deltas require evidence.
body: {$this cd:deltaBasis cd:deltaBasis_Measured; cd:resetDetected ?r; cd:deltaValue ?d; cd:startReading ?a; cd:endReading ?b; cd:registerEpoch/cd:multiplier ?m. ?a cd:numericValue ?x; cd:observedAt ?at. ?b cd:numericValue ?y; cd:observedAt ?bt. FILTER(?r || ?m<=0 || ?bt<=?at || ?d<0 || ?d!=(?y-?x)*?m)} UNION {$this cd:deltaBasis cd:deltaBasis_Estimated. FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this cd:deltaEvidence ?e}}

title: Billing readiness requires completed charging and resolved usage, authorization, price, tax, commercial responsibility and blocking issues.
body: $this cd:readinessState cd:readinessState_Ready; cd:usageComplete ?u; cd:priceResolved ?p; cd:taxResolved ?t; cd:authorizationResolved ?a; cd:responsibilityResolved ?r; cd:openBlockingIssueCount ?n. FILTER(!?u || !?p || !?t || !?a || !?r || ?n!=0 || !EXISTS {$this cd:session/cd:sessionState cd:sessionState_Completed} || !EXISTS {$this cd:readinessEvidence ?e})

title: A local debit CDR carries a ready billing decision for the same completed session.
body: $this cd:recordOrigin cd:recordOrigin_Local; cd:recordKind cd:recordKind_Debit; cd:session ?s. FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this cd:billingReadiness ?a. ?a cd:readinessState cd:readinessState_Ready; cd:session ?s}

title: Credit CDRs preserve parties and currency, reverse the original totals and cannot credit the same debit more than once.
body: { $this cd:recordKind cd:recordKind_Credit; cd:currency ?cur; cd:issuer ?issuer; cd:recipient ?recipient; cd:netAmount ?n; cd:taxAmount ?t; cd:grossAmount ?g. FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this cd:originalChargeRecord ?old. ?old cd:recordKind cd:recordKind_Debit; cd:currency ?cur; cd:issuer ?issuer; cd:recipient ?recipient; cd:netAmount ?on; cd:taxAmount ?ot; cd:grossAmount ?og. FILTER(?old!=$this && ?n=-?on && ?t=-?ot && ?g=-?og)} } UNION { $this cd:recordKind cd:recordKind_Credit; cd:originalChargeRecord ?original. ?other a cd:ChargeDetailRecord; cd:recordKind cd:recordKind_Credit; cd:originalChargeRecord ?original. FILTER(?other!=$this) }

title: Corrections form an acyclic lineage and cannot replace a record with itself.
body: $this cd:originalRecord ?old; cd:correctingRecord ?new. FILTER(?old=?new || EXISTS {?old (^cd:originalRecord/cd:correctingRecord)+ ?old})

title: Outstanding liability reconciles original charges, credits, collected money and authorized write-offs.
body: $this cd:originalAmount ?o; cd:creditedAmount ?c; cd:collectedAmount ?p; cd:writtenOffAmount ?w; cd:outstandingAmount ?r. FILTER(?o<0 || ?c<0 || ?p<0 || ?w<0 || ?r<0 || ?r!=?o-?c-?p-?w)

title: A settled position has no residual liability; a written-off position records the write-off.
body: $this cd:positionState ?s; cd:outstandingAmount ?v; cd:writtenOffAmount ?w. FILTER((?s=cd:positionState_Settled && ?v!=0) || (?s=cd:positionState_WrittenOff && (?v!=0 || ?w<=0)))

title: Posted allocations use confirmed collections, positive amounts and matching currencies.
body: $this cd:allocationState cd:allocationState_Posted; cd:allocatedAmount ?v; cd:currency ?c; cd:paymentCapture ?p; cd:financialPosition ?f. FILTER(?v<=0 || !EXISTS {?p cd:captureState cd:captureState_Confirmed; cd:currency ?c} || !EXISTS {?f cd:currency ?c})

title: Total posted allocations never spend a collection more than once.
body: $this cd:capturedAmount ?limit. {SELECT $this (SUM(?v) AS ?total) WHERE {?a a cd:PaymentAllocation; cd:paymentCapture $this; cd:allocationState cd:allocationState_Posted; cd:allocatedAmount ?v} GROUP BY $this} FILTER(?total>?limit)

title: Missing-record cases allow an absent side with a locator; comparison cases require both actual records.
body: $this cd:mismatchKind ?k. FILTER((?k=cd:mismatchKind_Missing && ((!EXISTS {$this cd:expectedRecord ?e} && !EXISTS {$this cd:observedRecord ?o} && !EXISTS {$this cd:expectedIdentifier ?i}) || (EXISTS {$this cd:expectedRecord ?e} && EXISTS {$this cd:observedRecord ?o}))) || (?k!=cd:mismatchKind_Missing && (!EXISTS {$this cd:expectedRecord ?e} || !EXISTS {$this cd:observedRecord ?o})))

title: Resolved reconciliation retains a resolution for the same case, a timestamp and explanation.
body: $this cd:caseState cd:caseState_Resolved. FILTER(!EXISTS {$this cd:resolvedAt ?t} || !EXISTS {$this cd:resolutionNote ?n} || !EXISTS {$this cd:reconciliationResolution ?r. ?r cd:reconciliationCase $this})

title: A corrected reconciliation identifies its immutable correction case.
body: $this cd:resolutionKind cd:resolutionKind_Corrected. FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this cd:correction ?c}

title: Disputes preserve response deadlines, reasoned closure and an explicit remedy when remedied.
body: {$this cd:openedAt ?o; cd:responseDueAt ?d. FILTER(?d<?o)} UNION {$this cd:disputeCaseState ?s. FILTER(?s IN (cd:disputeCaseState_Remedied,cd:disputeCaseState_Closed)) FILTER(!EXISTS {$this cd:resolutionEvidence ?e} || (?s=cd:disputeCaseState_Remedied && !EXISTS {$this cd:remedyRecord ?r}))}

title: Collection escalation pauses for unresolved disputes against the position or its source record even without an explicit dispute link.
body: { $this cd:actionKind cd:actionKind_Escalate. { $this cd:financialPosition/cd:positionState cd:positionState_Disputed } UNION {$this cd:serviceDispute/cd:disputeCaseState ?s. FILTER(?s IN (cd:disputeCaseState_Opened,cd:disputeCaseState_Investigating,cd:disputeCaseState_Accepted))} } UNION { $this cd:actionKind cd:actionKind_Escalate; cd:financialPosition ?position. ?dispute a cd:ServiceDispute; cd:disputedRecord ?record; cd:disputeCaseState ?state. FILTER(?state IN (cd:disputeCaseState_Opened,cd:disputeCaseState_Investigating,cd:disputeCaseState_Accepted)) FILTER(?record=?position || EXISTS {?position cd:sourceRecord ?record}) }

title: Approval cannot release a partner settlement with unresolved differences or missing approval evidence.
body: $this cd:approvalState cd:approvalState_Approved; cd:openDifferenceCount ?n. FILTER(?n!=0 || !EXISTS {$this cd:approvedAt ?t} || !EXISTS {$this cd:approvalEvidence ?e})

title: Partner settlement totals equal their items; released batches retain an approved release decision.
body: { $this cd:netAmount ?n; cd:taxAmount ?t; cd:grossAmount ?g. {SELECT $this (SUM(?in) AS ?sn) (SUM(?it) AS ?st) (SUM(?ig) AS ?sg) WHERE {$this cd:settlementItem ?i. ?i cd:netAmount ?in; cd:taxAmount ?it; cd:grossAmount ?ig} GROUP BY $this} FILTER(?n!=?sn || ?t!=?st || ?g!=?sg) } UNION { $this cd:settlementState ?state. FILTER(?state IN (cd:settlementState_Approved,cd:settlementState_Invoiced,cd:settlementState_Settled)) FILTER NOT EXISTS {?approval a cd:SettlementApproval; cd:settlementBatch $this; cd:approvalState cd:approvalState_Approved} }

title: Approved reimbursement matches claimant, currency, amount, rate and eligible measured energy of the claim.
body: $this cd:approvalState cd:approvalState_Approved; cd:reimbursementRecord ?r; cd:entitledAccount ?a; cd:approvedAmount ?v; cd:approvedRate ?rate; cd:approvedEnergyKWh ?k; cd:currency ?c. FILTER(?v<0 || ?rate<0 || ?k<0 || !EXISTS {$this cd:approvalEvidence ?e} || !EXISTS {$this cd:approvedAt ?t} || !EXISTS {?r cd:beneficiaryAccount ?a; cd:currency ?c; cd:reimbursementAmount ?v; cd:reimbursementRate ?rate; cd:reimbursableEnergyKWh ?k; cd:session/cd:importedEnergyKWh ?measured. FILTER(?k<=?measured)})

title: Paid reimbursements identify an approved claim and a confirmed payout with matching amount and currency.
body: $this cd:reimbursementState cd:reimbursementState_Paid; cd:reimbursementAmount ?a; cd:currency ?c. FILTER(!EXISTS {$this cd:reimbursementApproval ?approval. ?approval cd:reimbursementRecord $this; cd:approvalState cd:approvalState_Approved} || !EXISTS {$this cd:payout ?p. ?p cd:payoutState cd:payoutState_Confirmed; cd:payoutAmount ?a; cd:currency ?c})

title: Consumed reservations reference consumption for the same allowance, billing period and session within the reserved amount.
body: $this cd:reservationState cd:reservationState_Consumed; cd:allowance ?a; cd:billingPeriod ?b; cd:session ?s; cd:reservedValue ?v. FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this cd:consumption ?c. ?c cd:allowance ?a; cd:billingPeriod ?b; cd:session ?s; cd:consumedValue ?used. FILTER(?used>=0 && ?used<=?v)}

title: A power decision stays within safety and contract limits even when optimization preferences are overridden.
body: $this cd:requestedPowerKW ?r; cd:feasiblePowerKW ?f; cd:safetyLimitKW ?s; cd:contractualLimitKW ?c; cd:controlDecision ?d. FILTER(?r<0 || ?f<0 || ?s<0 || ?c<0 || ?f>?s || ?f>?c || ?f>?r || (?d=cd:controlDecision_Accepted && ?f!=?r) || (?d=cd:controlDecision_Rejected && ?f!=0))

title: An accepted export decision requires an export agreement valid throughout the control interval at the same site.
body: $this cd:energyDirection cd:energyDirection_Export; cd:controlDecision ?d; cd:interval ?i; cd:chargingUnit/cd:station/cd:site ?site. FILTER(?d!=cd:controlDecision_Rejected) ?i cd:startsAt ?start; cd:endsAt ?end. FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this cd:exportAgreement ?a. ?a cd:exportPermitted true; cd:site ?site; cd:validFrom ?from. OPTIONAL {?a cd:validUntil ?until} FILTER(?start>=?from && (!BOUND(?until)||?end<=?until))}

title: An override is authorized for this unit and covers the entire control interval.
body: $this cd:overrideAuthorization ?o; cd:chargingUnit ?u; cd:interval ?i. ?i cd:startsAt ?s; cd:endsAt ?e. FILTER NOT EXISTS {?o cd:authorizedScope ?u; cd:validFrom ?a; cd:validUntil ?b. FILTER(?s>=?a && ?e<=?b)}

title: Fulfilled rights requests require verified identity, completion time and retained response evidence.
body: $this cd:requestState cd:requestState_Fulfilled; cd:identityVerified ?v. FILTER(!?v || !EXISTS {$this cd:completedAt ?t} || !EXISTS {$this cd:responseEvidence ?e})

title: Refusal of a rights request retains a reason and a communicated response.
body: $this cd:requestState cd:requestState_Refused. FILTER(!EXISTS {$this cd:refusalReason ?r} || !EXISTS {$this cd:responseEvidence ?e})

title: Completed disposition retains evidence and respects explicit holds and independently recorded active account-wide holds.
body: { $this cd:dispositionState cd:dispositionState_Completed. FILTER(!EXISTS {$this cd:completedAt ?t} || !EXISTS {$this cd:dispositionEvidence ?e} || EXISTS {$this cd:legalHold/cd:holdState cd:holdState_Active}) } UNION { $this cd:dispositionState cd:dispositionState_Completed; cd:subjectAccount ?account. ?hold a cd:LegalHold; cd:heldRecord ?account; cd:holdState cd:holdState_Active. }

title: Holds have a future review relative to inception and explicit release evidence in time.
body: {$this cd:validFrom ?s; cd:reviewAt ?e. FILTER(?e<=?s)} UNION {$this cd:holdState cd:holdState_Released. FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this cd:releasedAt ?t}}

title: International personal-data transfers retain an explicit safeguards assessment.
body: $this cd:internationalTransfer true. FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this cd:transferSafeguardEvidence ?e}

title: Permission decisions require an active time-valid scoped grant and cannot authorize a currently disabled principal.
body: { $this cd:accessDecision cd:accessDecision_Permit; cd:grantee ?p; cd:scopeRecord ?r; cd:permission ?perm; cd:decidedAt ?t. FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this cd:accessGrant ?g. ?g cd:grantState cd:grantState_Active; cd:grantee ?p; cd:scopeRecord ?r; cd:securityRole/cd:permission ?perm; cd:validFrom ?s. OPTIONAL {?g cd:validUntil ?e} FILTER(?t>=?s && (!BOUND(?e)||?t<?e))} } UNION { $this cd:accessDecision cd:accessDecision_Permit; cd:grantee/cd:principalState cd:principalState_Disabled. }

title: Valid artifact verification retains a matching computed digest and verification evidence.
body: $this cd:verificationState cd:verificationState_Valid; cd:artifact/cd:contentDigest ?expected. FILTER(!EXISTS {$this cd:computedDigest ?expected} || !EXISTS {$this cd:verificationEvidence ?e})

title: Availability commitments use a proportion between zero and one.
body: $this cd:targetFraction ?v. FILTER(?v<0 || ?v>1)

title: Closed service breaches retain completed remediation or a contractual remedy.
body: $this cd:breachState cd:breachState_Closed. FILTER(!EXISTS {$this cd:workOrder/cd:workState cd:workState_Completed} && !EXISTS {$this cd:remedyRecord ?r})

title: A passed recovery rehearsal meets both time and data-loss objectives.
body: $this cd:recoveryResult cd:recoveryResult_Passed; cd:recoveryTimeObjectiveSeconds ?rto; cd:recoveryPointObjectiveSeconds ?rpo; cd:achievedRecoverySeconds ?time; cd:achievedDataLossSeconds ?loss. FILTER(?time>?rto || ?loss>?rpo)

title: Completed migration reconciles all expected records without rejects and revokes obsolete source credentials.
body: $this cd:migrationState cd:migrationState_Completed; cd:expectedRecordCount ?e; cd:migratedRecordCount ?m; cd:rejectedRecordCount ?r; cd:sourceCredentialsRevoked ?revoked. FILTER(?e!=?m || ?r!=0 || !?revoked || !EXISTS {$this cd:reconciliationEvidence ?x})

title: Current lifecycle snapshots agree with the current subject state and any cited transition.
body: $this cd:targetRecord ?r; cd:stateProperty ?p; cd:stateValue ?v; cd:effectiveAt ?time; cd:snapshotKind ?kind. FILTER((?kind=cd:snapshotKind_Current && !EXISTS {?r ?p ?v}) || EXISTS {$this cd:basisTransition ?t. FILTER NOT EXISTS {?t cd:targetRecord ?r; cd:stateProperty ?p; cd:nextState ?v; cd:transitionedAt ?at. FILTER(?at<=?time)}})

title: Chained transitions preserve record, property, state continuity and nondecreasing time without circular history.
body: { $this cd:previousTransition ?prev; cd:targetRecord ?r; cd:stateProperty ?p; cd:previousState ?s; cd:transitionedAt ?now. FILTER NOT EXISTS {?prev cd:targetRecord ?r; cd:stateProperty ?p; cd:nextState ?s; cd:transitionedAt ?before. FILTER(?now>=?before)} } UNION { $this cd:previousTransition+ $this. }

title: An adapter cannot declare a feature both supported and unsupported.
body: $this cd:supportedFeature ?f; cd:unsupportedFeature ?f.

title: Completed business journeys retain evidence and only successfully completed, compensated or explicitly skipped steps.
body: $this cd:processState cd:processState_Completed. FILTER(!EXISTS {$this cd:processEvidence ?e} || EXISTS {$this cd:processStep/cd:stepState ?s. FILTER(?s NOT IN (cd:stepState_Succeeded,cd:stepState_Compensated,cd:stepState_Skipped))})

title: Successful steps have output and evidence; compensated steps identify their compensating record.
body: $this cd:stepState ?s. FILTER((?s=cd:stepState_Succeeded && (!EXISTS {$this cd:outputRecord ?o} || !EXISTS {$this cd:stepEvidence ?e})) || (?s=cd:stepState_Compensated && !EXISTS {$this cd:compensationRecord ?c}))

title: Step sequence numbers are unique within a business journey.
body: $this cd:processStep ?a,?b. ?a cd:stepSequence ?n. ?b cd:stepSequence ?n. FILTER(?a!=?b)

title: Credit-note currency and issuer match the original invoice and cumulative credits stay within its gross amount.
body: $this cd:currency ?cur; cd:issuer ?issuer; cd:originalInvoice ?i. FILTER(!EXISTS {?i cd:currency ?cur; cd:issuer ?issuer} || EXISTS {?i cd:grossAmount ?limit. {SELECT ?i (SUM(?v) AS ?total) WHERE {?note a cd:CreditNote; cd:originalInvoice ?i; cd:creditAmount ?v} GROUP BY ?i} FILTER(?total>?limit)})

title: Remaining allowance reconciles opening rollover, grants, consumption, reservations and expired value without a negative balance.
body: $this cd:openingValue ?o; cd:grantedValue ?g; cd:consumedValue ?c; cd:reservedValue ?r; cd:expiredValue ?e; cd:closingValue ?b. FILTER(?o<0 || ?g<0 || ?c<0 || ?r<0 || ?e<0 || ?b<0 || ?b!=?o+?g-?c-?r-?e)

title: Allowance totals reconcile actual usage and reservations for the same allowance, period and session customer.
body: { $this cd:allowance ?allowance; cd:billingPeriod ?period; cd:consumedValue ?c; cd:reservedValue ?r. {SELECT $this (SUM(?used) AS ?totalUsed) WHERE {OPTIONAL {?x a cd:AllowanceConsumption; cd:allowanceBalance $this; cd:consumedValue ?used}} GROUP BY $this} {SELECT $this (SUM(?held) AS ?totalHeld) WHERE {OPTIONAL {?x a cd:BenefitReservation; cd:allowanceBalance $this; cd:reservationState cd:reservationState_Active; cd:reservedValue ?held}} GROUP BY $this} FILTER(?c!=COALESCE(?totalUsed,0) || ?r!=COALESCE(?totalHeld,0) || EXISTS {?item cd:allowanceBalance $this; cd:allowance ?other. FILTER(?other!=?allowance)} || EXISTS {?item cd:allowanceBalance $this; cd:billingPeriod ?other. FILTER(?other!=?period)}) } UNION { $this cd:customer ?owner. ?item cd:allowanceBalance $this; cd:session ?session. FILTER NOT EXISTS {?session cd:customer ?owner} }

title: Money-denominated allowances identify a currency instead of being treated as energy credits.
body: $this cd:allowance/cd:allowanceDimension cd:allowanceDimension_Money. FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this cd:currency ?c}

title: Session intervals are contained within the parent session.
body: $this cd:session ?s; cd:interval ?i. ?s cd:startedAt ?start. OPTIONAL {?s cd:endedAt ?end} ?i cd:startsAt ?a; cd:endsAt ?b. FILTER(?a<?start || (BOUND(?end) && ?b>?end))

title: One online selection set cannot expose overlapping candidate versions of the same tariff identity.
body: $this (cd:defaultTariff|cd:tariffAssignment/cd:assignedTariff) ?x,?y. ?x cd:tariff ?t; cd:validFrom ?a. OPTIONAL {?x cd:validUntil ?b} ?y cd:tariff ?t; cd:validFrom ?c. OPTIONAL {?y cd:validUntil ?d} FILTER(?x!=?y && (!BOUND(?b)||?c<?b) && (!BOUND(?d)||?a<?d))

title: Calendar-date values must identify real Gregorian dates.
body: $this ?p ?v. ?p cd:calendarDate true. BIND(xsd:integer(SUBSTR(STR(?v),1,4)) AS ?y) BIND(xsd:integer(SUBSTR(STR(?v),6,2)) AS ?m) BIND(xsd:integer(SUBSTR(STR(?v),9,2)) AS ?d) BIND((?y - FLOOR(?y/4)*4 = 0 && (?y - FLOOR(?y/100)*100 != 0 || ?y - FLOOR(?y/400)*400 = 0)) AS ?leap) FILTER(?y<1 || ?m<1 || ?m>12 || ?d<1 || ?d>31 || (?m IN (4,6,9,11) && ?d>30) || (?m=2 && (?d>29 || (?d=29 && !?leap))))

title: Present temporal slices have an immutable graph and digest; retractions have neither.
body: {$this cd:sliceState cd:sliceState_Present. FILTER(!EXISTS {$this cd:payloadGraph ?g} || !EXISTS {$this cd:contentDigest ?d})} UNION {$this cd:sliceState cd:sliceState_Retracted. FILTER(EXISTS {$this cd:payloadGraph ?g} || EXISTS {$this cd:contentDigest ?d})}

title: Commit slices form a non-overlapping effective-time map.
body: $this cd:temporalSlice ?x,?y. ?x cd:validFrom ?a. ?y cd:validFrom ?c. OPTIONAL {?x cd:validUntil ?b} OPTIONAL {?y cd:validUntil ?d} FILTER(?x!=?y && (!BOUND(?b)||?c<?b) && (!BOUND(?d)||?a<?d))

title: Successor commits preserve scope and tenant, advance recording time and sequence, and cannot branch or cycle.
body: {$this cd:previousCommit ?p; cd:recordedAt ?now; cd:commitSequence ?n; cd:tenant ?tenant; cd:snapshotScope ?scope. FILTER NOT EXISTS {?p cd:tenant ?tenant; cd:snapshotScope ?scope; cd:recordedAt ?before; cd:commitSequence ?old. FILTER(?now>?before && ?n=?old+1)}} UNION {$this cd:previousCommit+ $this} UNION {$this cd:previousCommit ?p. ?other a cd:TemporalCommit; cd:previousCommit ?p. FILTER(?other!=$this)} UNION {$this cd:commitSequence ?n. FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this cd:previousCommit ?p} FILTER(?n!=1)} UNION {$this cd:tenant ?t; cd:snapshotScope ?scope. ?other a cd:TemporalCommit; cd:tenant ?t; cd:snapshotScope ?scope. FILTER(?other!=$this) FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this cd:previousCommit ?p} FILTER NOT EXISTS {?other cd:previousCommit ?q}} UNION {$this cd:tenant ?t; cd:snapshotScope ?scope; cd:recordedAt ?time. ?other a cd:TemporalCommit; cd:tenant ?t; cd:snapshotScope ?scope; cd:recordedAt ?time. FILTER(?other!=$this)}

title: Committed projections have complete, unique, non-future and monotonic source checkpoints.
body: {$this cd:sourceWatermark ?w. FILTER NOT EXISTS {?w cd:watermarkState cd:watermarkState_Complete}} UNION {$this cd:recordedAt ?r; cd:sourceWatermark/cd:watermarkAt ?w. FILTER(?w>?r)} UNION {$this cd:sourceWatermark ?x,?y. ?x cd:sourceSystem ?source; cd:sourcePartition ?part. ?y cd:sourceSystem ?source; cd:sourcePartition ?part. FILTER(?x!=?y)} UNION {$this cd:previousCommit/cd:sourceWatermark ?old. ?old cd:sourceSystem ?source; cd:sourcePartition ?part; cd:sourceOffset ?offset; cd:completeThrough ?time. FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this cd:sourceWatermark ?new. ?new cd:sourceSystem ?source; cd:sourcePartition ?part; cd:sourceOffset ?newOffset; cd:completeThrough ?newTime. FILTER(?newOffset>=?offset && ?newTime>=?time)}}

title: A source completeness cutoff cannot exceed its watermark observation time.
body: $this cd:completeThrough ?t; cd:watermarkAt ?w. FILTER(?t>?w)

title: Assignments of a credential cannot overlap inside a coherent validation snapshot.
body: $this cd:credential ?k; cd:validFrom ?a; cd:validUntil ?b. ?other a cd:CredentialAssignment; cd:credential ?k; cd:validFrom ?c; cd:validUntil ?d. FILTER(?other!=$this && ?a<?d && ?c<?b)

title: Coincident module allocations must remain within cabinet power capacity.
body: $this cd:totalCabinetPowerKW ?capacity. {SELECT $this ?point (SUM(?power) AS ?total) WHERE {{SELECT DISTINCT $this ?point WHERE {?anchor a cd:PowerModuleAllocation; cd:powerCabinet $this; cd:interval/cd:startsAt ?point}} ?allocation a cd:PowerModuleAllocation; cd:powerCabinet $this; cd:allocatedPowerKW ?power; cd:interval ?i. ?i cd:startsAt ?s; cd:endsAt ?e. FILTER(?s<=?point && ?point<?e)} GROUP BY $this ?point} FILTER(?total>?capacity)

title: Confirmed bookings cannot allocate the same charging unit during overlapping windows.
body: $this cd:bookingState cd:bookingState_Confirmed; cd:chargingUnit ?unit; cd:bookingWindow ?i. ?i cd:startsAt ?a; cd:endsAt ?b. ?other a cd:Booking; cd:bookingState cd:bookingState_Confirmed; cd:chargingUnit ?unit; cd:bookingWindow ?j. ?j cd:startsAt ?c; cd:endsAt ?d. FILTER(?other!=$this && ?a<?d && ?c<?b)

title: Snapshot selection must identify the latest matching commit and slice, or explicitly report unavailability.
body: { $this cd:selectionState ?state. OPTIONAL {$this cd:selectedCommit ?c} OPTIONAL {$this cd:selectedSlice ?s} FILTER((?state=cd:selectionState_Unavailable && (BOUND(?c)||BOUND(?s))) || (?state!=cd:selectionState_Unavailable && (!BOUND(?c)||!BOUND(?s)))) } UNION { $this cd:selectedCommit ?c; cd:selectedSlice ?s; cd:selectionState ?state; cd:validAt ?v; cd:knownAt ?k; cd:snapshotScope ?scope; cd:tenant ?tenant. FILTER NOT EXISTS {?c cd:temporalSlice ?s; cd:snapshotScope ?scope; cd:tenant ?tenant; cd:recordedAt ?r. ?s cd:validFrom ?a; cd:sliceState ?ss. OPTIONAL {?s cd:validUntil ?b} FILTER(?r<=?k && ?a<=?v && (!BOUND(?b)||?v<?b) && ((?state=cd:selectionState_Present && ?ss=cd:sliceState_Present)||(?state=cd:selectionState_Retracted && ?ss=cd:sliceState_Retracted))) FILTER NOT EXISTS {?new a cd:TemporalCommit; cd:tenant ?tenant; cd:snapshotScope ?scope; cd:recordedAt ?nr. FILTER(?r<?nr && ?nr<=?k)}} } UNION { $this cd:selectionState cd:selectionState_Unavailable; cd:validAt ?v; cd:knownAt ?k; cd:snapshotScope ?scope; cd:tenant ?tenant. ?c a cd:TemporalCommit; cd:tenant ?tenant; cd:snapshotScope ?scope; cd:recordedAt ?r; cd:temporalSlice ?s. ?s cd:validFrom ?a. OPTIONAL {?s cd:validUntil ?b} FILTER(?r<=?k && ?a<=?v && (!BOUND(?b)||?v<?b)) FILTER NOT EXISTS {?new a cd:TemporalCommit; cd:tenant ?tenant; cd:snapshotScope ?scope; cd:recordedAt ?nr. FILTER(?r<?nr && ?nr<=?k)} }
